notes: operator_candidate_patch is a CANDIDATE only — Finance / operator must verify imported_total_hours against the contract record before applying it. The Zoho snapshot can drift from the contract's stated block size.

Setting total_hours alone is INSUFFICIENT for historically consumed boh / boh_with_boa contracts. Without a consumed-hours baseline, every newly approved entry would push contract.hours_consumed from zero, under-counting historical consumption.

Preferred path for the consumed-hours baseline may be replaying historical Zoho Timesheets/time logs against the imported project once that export is available — that writes real contract_time_applications rows and is auditable. Directly patching contract.hours_consumed from imported_consumed_hours is the candidate fallback; it requires Finance / operator sign-off because the Zoho snapshot can drift from the ledger of approved entries.
Sell rates are never auto-derived; the Zoho export has no rate column. needs_finance_review='hourly_rate' marks the contracts where Finance must supply a number.
There is no --execute flag. The hydration executor is a separate, reviewed slice.

readiness_dimensions.approval_debit_ready: Approval would produce defensible contract balance updates. fixed_fee / boa / other never debit a block; boh and boh_with_boa need BOTH total_hours AND a consumed-hours baseline so contract.hours_consumed has a meaningful denominator AND starts from the right historical value.
readiness_dimensions.billable_draft_entry_ready: Default POST /api/time-entries (is_billable=true) would save. fixed_fee bypasses the 409 sell-rate gate; all others need a positive contract.hourly_rate or resource_types[].sell_rate.
readiness_dimensions.consumed_hours_baseline_ready: boh / boh_with_boa only. True when imported_consumed_hours is zero/missing OR when canonical contract.hours_consumed is already positive. False when the Zoho snapshot says the contract has historical consumption but the canonical counter is still zero — newly approved entries would then under-count consumption relative to the historical block.
readiness_dimensions.hydration_required: Aggregate flag. True when any of the five readiness dimensions is False AND the corresponding gap is relevant for the contract type.
readiness_dimensions.non_billable_draft_entry_ready: POST with is_billable=false (or billing_type=non_billable) would save. True for every contract that resolves.
readiness_dimensions.resource_type_entry_ready: POST that supplies resource_type_id would pass the membership check. Requires contract.resources[] to contain at least one (user_id, resource_type_id, cost_rate) triple.
